title: WorkJournal
description: Per-run durable record of intent and progress. On lease expiry, crash, retry, or escalation the journal is replayed — never the transcript. This is what makes stateless workers viable: the worker is disposable because the journal is not. Written outside the context window before compaction, not recovered from a summary afterwards.

goal.description: Copied verbatim from the work order. Never paraphrased — paraphrase is where drift starts.

blocked_on.description: What is needed to proceed, and from whom. Null when not blocked.

hypotheses.description: The field that earns the journal its place: it stops attempt N+1 re-testing what attempt N disproved. Feeds falsified_hypotheses in the failure bundle.

evidence.description: What established the status — a test name, a log line, a file:line.

decisions_made.description: Choices a successor would otherwise have to re-make, with the reason.

next_step.description: The single next action. A successor must be able to start from this line alone.

compactions.description: How many times this run's context was compacted. Rising counts with falling progress indicate the work order is oversized (decomposition defect).
